description:
Nestled South of the Boulevard and within the prestigious Carpenter Community Charter School district, this 2015-built bottom-level residence is just steps from the thriving energy of Ventura Boulevard. Just a short stroll to trendy eateries, Trader Joe’s, Studio City Farmers Market, local boutiques, and fitness studios. Convenient to the 101 freeway and major film studios.

The home welcomes you with an airy, open-concept floor plan anchored by 10-foot ceilings and refined designer finishes. The kitchen features a center island with breakfast bar seating, ample cabinet space, soft-closing drawers, and a sleek glass subway tile backsplash.The spacious primary bedroom includes a large walk-in closet and a spa-like bath with a deep soaking tub, separate shower, and dual vanities. Two additional spacious bedrooms are ideal for a home office or creative space. The hallway leads to a bathroom with a walk-in shower, and a powder room is located near the entrance, all featuring motion sensor lights. Engineered wood flooring, tile, recessed lighting, and opaque glass interior doors throughout. Equipped with a tankless water heater, double-pane windows, and in-unit laundry.

Rooftop Escape: Enjoy 360-degree panoramic views of the Hollywood Hills and mountains from the community rooftop deck, complete with lounge seating and BBQ area.

Parking & Security: Gated subterranean garage with two tandem parking spots, guest parking, and secure gated entry. Live where the best of Studio City is your backyard.
